documents.title: Houseplant care notes (demo)
documents.text:
Fern: likes indirect light and steady moisture. Water every Tuesday and Friday, a little more in a hot week. Mist the leaves when the air is dry.

Snake plant: almost no care. Water once every two to three weeks, only when the soil is fully dry. Too much water rots the roots.

Basil on the window sill: water when the top of the soil feels dry. Pinch off flowers so the leaves stay sweet.

documents.title: Lemon tart recipe (demo)
documents.text:
Pastry: 200 g flour, 100 g cold butter, 50 g sugar, one egg yolk, a spoon of cold water. Rub the butter into the flour, add the rest, rest the dough for 30 minutes, then blind bake at 180 C for 15 minutes.

Filling: three lemons (zest and juice), 150 g sugar, three eggs, 100 ml cream. Whisk, pour into the warm shell and bake at 150 C for about 25 minutes, until it barely wobbles in the middle.

Serve cold with a dusting of icing sugar.

documents.title: Good morning in five languages (demo)
documents.text:
English: good morning. Spanish: buenos dias. French: bonjour. Japanese: ohayou gozaimasu. Tamil: kaalai vanakkam.

Practice plan: one language a day, the robot says it first and Sam repeats it back.
